how_to_reproduce: POST to the workflow's webhook with {"text": "...", "session_id": "..."}. Audio is optional; a text payload exercises everything downstream of transcription.
note: latency_measured_ms is real per-stage wall clock. Transcription is near zero on these runs because they used the text-payload path; a real audio upload adds the speech-to-text call.

runs.transcript: What are your opening hours on Sunday?
runs.reply_text: We are open from 11am to 4pm on Sunday.
runs.assertion: The reply states 11am to 4pm, which is exactly what the tool returned for Sunday. Real text-to-speech audio was produced and returned as binary.

runs.transcript: I want to cancel my order, the reference is AB-99120.

governance.reason: MEDIUM risk cleared all 5 deterministic policy checks.

runs.refusal: Approved by governance, but this demo never executes data-changing actions. The approval has been recorded for a human to action.
runs.assertion: The safety property held. The intent was correctly recognised as data-changing, the slot was extracted, the request was routed to Governance, and tool_executed stayed false even after approval.
runs.note: Governance resolved this at the MEDIUM tier rather than escalating to a human, because the demo target 'sandbox' is on the auto-approve allow-list. Pointing it at a system that is not on that list escalates instead, which is what governance fixture G03 demonstrates.

not_yet_tested: The audio upload path. Both runs used the text payload, so the OpenAI Whisper transcription node is STRUCTURALLY VALIDATED but not exercised end to end. The text-to-speech node IS exercised (V01 produced real audio).
